'''Farh j'Hien''' was a [[Sith battlelord]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].

==Biography==
J'Hien served the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as a [[General/Legends|general]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kei Loo Bross]] captured a [[Unidentified Sith warrior|Sith warrior]] who was bonded to j'Hien through Sith battlelord rituals and included the warrior's description of j'Hien in his work, ''[[Speculations on Tactics of the Sith]]''.
